a) During ‘pre-open’ the system accepts orders (permitted orders). Orders may be amended or cancelled during pre-open.
However, no executions take place at this stage.
b) During ‘open-auction’, the system temporarily closes the order book and starts matching orders. It establishes the
opening price and determines the orders to be executed according to the rules for the open-auction period.
c) During ‘regular trading’ new orders are continually matched against existing orders in the order book according to the rules
for the regular trading session. If an order cannot be executed it is stored in the order book depending on its attributes.
d) During ‘close trading’ the system computes the closing price for each security. During closing the state of the market is
displayed as “closing”. Once the closing process is complete, the status of the market is displayed as “closed”.
